# Design System: Гардероб (Wardrobe App)

**Project Type:** Productivity Tool — Wardrobe Organizer + AI Outfit Generator
**Target Audience:** C-end consumers (fashion-conscious, practical, mobile-first)
**Style Direction:** Minimalism & Swiss Style with Fashion Rose + Gold Accent
**Platform:** Web (single-file HTML, CSS custom properties, vanilla JS)
**Last Updated:** 2026-11-22
**Generated By:** ui-ux-pro-max `--design-system`

---

## 1. Pattern: Scroll-Triggered Storytelling

**Conversion Focus:** Keep narrative understandable without scroll-driven effects. Use progress indicator. Mobile: simplify animations. Keep DOM reading order complete; disable parallax and scroll-scrub under reduced motion.

**Section Flow:**
1. **Intro Hook** — Hero: value prop + demo + CTA
2. **Chapter 1 (Problem)** — "Облечи се за секунди" + pain points
3. **Chapter 2 (Journey)** — 3-step process (upload → describe → generate)
4. **Chapter 3 (Solution)** — App dashboard with live data
5. **Climax CTA** — Band: "Първият ти аутфит..." + primary CTA

**CTA Placement:** End of each chapter (mini) + Final climax CTA

---

## 2. Style: Minimalism & Swiss Style

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| **Keywords** | Clean, simple, spacious, functional, white space, high contrast, geometric, sans-serif, grid-based, essential |
| **Mode Support** | Light ✓ Dark ✓ |
| **Best For** | Enterprise apps, dashboards, documentation, SaaS, professional tools |
| **Performance** | Cost: low | Drivers: none |
| **Accessibility** | Risk: low | Requires: contrast-text-4.5, keyboard, visible-focus, reduced-motion |

**Anti-patterns to Avoid:**
- Excessive decoration
- Gradients on primary surfaces
- Multiple shadow layers
- Decorative borders (edge stripes)
- Emoji as structural icons

## 5. Spacing & Layout

### Spacing Scale (CSS Variables)

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `--space-xs` | 4px | Icon gaps, tight inline |
| `--space-sm` | 8px | Chip gaps, form field gaps |
| `--space-md` | 16px | Card padding, section gaps |
| `--space-lg` | 24px | Page padding, sheet padding |
| `--space-xl` | 32px | Section vertical rhythm |
| `--space-2xl` | 48px | Hero/band padding |
| `--space-3xl` | 72px | Large section separation |

### Border Radius

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `--radius-sm` | 12px | Inputs, selects, small cards |
| `--radius-md` | 16px | Item frames, picker cards |
| `--radius-lg` | 22px | Main frames, sheets, empty states |
| `--radius-full` | 999px | Buttons, pills, chips, FAB, avatar |

### Grid & Container

- **Max Width:** 1080px (`.wrap`)
- **Grid Columns:** 2 (mobile) → 3 (tablet ≥700px) → 4 (desktop ≥980px)
- **Gutter:** 14px (mobile) → 20px (tablet+)
- **Safe Areas:** `env(safe-area-inset-*)` on all fixed/floating elements

## 6. Effects & Motion

### Transitions

| Property | Duration | Easing | Usage |
|----------|----------|--------|-------|
| `--transition-fast` | 100ms | `ease` | Transform (press), opacity |
| `--transition-base` | 150ms | `ease` | Background, border, color |
| `--transition-slow` | 200-250ms | `ease-out` | Box-shadow, hover lift |

### Shadows

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `--shadow` | `0 12px 40px rgba(15,23,42,.1)` | Cards, frames, sheets, FAB, demo |
| `--shadow-hover` | `0 16px 48px rgba(15,23,42,.15)` | Frame hover |

### Animations

- **Sheet Entry:** `up` — 250ms ease-out, `transform: translateY(24px)` + opacity
- **Reduced Motion:** Disables sheet animation + `scroll-behavior: auto`
- **No parallax, no scroll-scrub, no auto-rotation**

## 7. Component Specifications

### Buttons

| Variant | Background | Text | Border | Hover | Active | Min Touch Target |
|---------|------------|------|--------|-------|--------|------------------|
| **Primary (`.btn`)** | `--color-primary` | `--color-on-primary` | None | `--color-secondary` | `scale(.98)` | 48×48px |
| **Secondary (`.btn.alt`)** | Transparent | `--color-foreground` | `--color-border` | `--color-muted` | `scale(.98)` | 48×48px |
| **Pill (`.pill`)** | `--color-card` | `--color-foreground` | `--color-border` | — | — | 44×44px |
| **Chip (`.chip`)** | Transparent | `--color-muted-foreground` | `--color-border` | — | — | 44×44px |
| **Chip Active** | `--color-primary` | `--color-on-primary` | `--color-primary` | — | — | 44×44px |
| **Tab** | Transparent | `--color-muted-foreground` | None | — | — | 44×44px |
| **Tab Active** | `--color-foreground` | `--color-background` | None | — | — | 44×44px |
| **FAB (`.fab`)** | `--color-primary` | `--color-on-primary` | None | `--color-secondary` | `scale(.95)` | **56×56px** |

### Cards

| Variant | Frame | Radius | Border | Shadow | Hover |
|---------|-------|--------|--------|--------|-------|
| **Outfit (`.frame`)** | 3:4 aspect | `--radius-lg` | `--color-border` | `--shadow` | `--shadow-hover` + primary border |
| **Item (`.frame.item`)** | 1:1 aspect | `--radius-md` | `--color-border` | `--shadow` | Same |
| **Sheet (`.frame.sq`)** | 1:1 aspect | `--radius-lg` | `--color-border` | `--shadow` | N/A |

### Form Controls

| Element | Background | Border | Radius | Focus |
|---------|------------|--------|--------|-------|
| Input / Select | `--color-background` | `--color-border` | `--radius-sm` | `--color-ring` + 3px spread |
| Color Swatch (`.sw button`) | Color value | `--color-border` | 50% | `--color-ring` outline 3px |
| File Drop (`.drop`) | `--color-background` | Dashed `--color-border` | 18px | Solid primary on hover |

### Navigation

- **Tabs:** Inline-flex, pill container, `aria-selected` state
- **Chips:** Horizontal scroll, `aria-pressed` for filter state
- **Back Link:** `← Гардероб` — arrow carries directional meaning (U21 exception)

## 8. Iconography

**Primary Library:** Phosphor Icons (`@phosphor-icons/react` equivalent via inline SVG)

| Icon | Phosphor Name | Usage | Accessibility |
|------|---------------|-------|---------------|
| Close | `X` | Modal close, dismiss | `aria-label="Затвори"` |
| Back | `ArrowLeft` | Nav back | Decorative (text carries meaning) |
| Add | `Plus` | FAB, create new | `aria-label="Добави дреха"` |
| Camera | `Camera` | Photo capture | Decorative (beside label) |
| Image | `Image` | Gallery upload | Decorative |
| Settings | `Gear` | Settings | Meaningful |
| Search | `MagnifyingGlass` | Search/filter | Meaningful |
| Filter | `Funnel` | Filter dropdown | Meaningful |
| Delete | `Trash` | Destructive action | Meaningful |
| Edit | `PencilSimple` | Edit action | Meaningful |
| Save | `FloppyDisk` | Save/persist | Meaningful |
| Check | `Check` | Success state | `aria-hidden="true"` |
| Warning | `Warning` | Warning state | Meaningful |
| Info | `Info` | Help/tooltip | Meaningful |
| Shopping Bag | `ShoppingBag` | Wardrobe/shopping | Meaningful |

**Custom Clothing Icons (Inline SVG):** Kept for category tiles (top, bottom, outer, shoes, acc). Marked `aria-hidden="true"` — decorative beside visible category name.

**Rules:**
- No emojis as structural icons
- Vector-only (SVG)
- Consistent stroke width (implied by viewBox)
- Semantic role per context (decorative/meaningful/interactive)

## 9. Accessibility Checklist

- [x] **Contrast:** All text ≥4.5:1 in both themes
- [x] **Focus Visible:** 3px ring with `--color-ring`, 2px offset
- [x] **Reduced Motion:** Sheet animation + scroll-behavior disabled
- [x] **Touch Targets:** ≥48×48px (FAB 56×56px, others 44×44px min)
- [x] **Safe Areas:** All fixed elements respect `env(safe-area-inset-*)`
- [x] **ARIA:** Tabs (`role="tablist"`), dialogs (`role="dialog" aria-modal="true"`), chips (`aria-pressed`), buttons (`aria-label` where icon-only)
- [x] **Labels:** All inputs have visible `<label for="id">`
- [x] **Decorative Icons:** `aria-hidden="true"` on category SVGs
- [x] **Color Not Sole Indicator:** Active states use background + border + text
- [x] **Keyboard:** All interactive elements reachable, Escape closes modals
- [x] **Language:** `lang="bg"` on `<html>`

## 10. Implementation Stack: HTML-Tailwind (CSS Custom Properties)

**Guidelines Applied:**
- ✅ Direct utilities in HTML (no `@apply` bloat)
- ✅ Consistent spacing scale via CSS variables
- ✅ Z-index scale: `z-10` (toast) → `z-30` (veil) → `z-40` (sheet) → `z-50` (FAB)
- ⚠️ **Note:** This project uses vanilla CSS custom properties, not Tailwind classes. The token architecture mirrors Tailwind's design token philosophy.

**Z-Index Scale:**
| Layer | Value | Elements |
|-------|-------|----------|
| Base | 0 | Content |
| Dropdown/Tooltip | 10 | — |
| Sticky Header | 20 | — |
| Modal Backdrop | 30 | `.veil` |
| Modal/Sheet | 40 | `.sheet` |
| FAB/Toast | 50 | `.fab`, `.toast` |

## 12. Design Dials (Optional Tuning)

```bash
# Marketing/Landing (spacious, minimal motion)
--variance 3 --motion 3 --density 3

# App Dashboard (denser, standard motion)
--variance 5 --motion 5 --density 7

# Bold/Brand Moment (asymmetric, complex motion)
--variance 8 --motion 7 --density 5
```

| Dial | Low (1-3) | Mid (4-7) | High (8-10) |
|------|-----------|-----------|-------------|
| `--variance` | Centered/minimal | Balanced/modern | Bold/asymmetric |
| `--motion` | Subtle micro | Standard scroll/stagger | Complex choreography |
| `--density` | Spacious (24-96px) | Standard (16-64px) | Dense/dashboard (8-32px) |

---

## 13. Anti-Patterns (Do Not Use)

| Pattern | Why Avoid | Alternative |
|---------|-----------|-------------|
| Emoji as icons | Font-dependent, inconsistent, no token control | Phosphor SVG icons |
| Edge accent stripes (`border-l-4` colored) | AI tell, encodes nothing, fights rounded corners | Neutral 1px border all sides |
| Decorative badges ("NEW", "AI", "🔥") | Flavor only, not real state | Only if bound to real data |
| Status dots without live data | Misleads users | Remove or bind to real status |
| Botsplaining captions ("Click to...") | Narrates visible behavior | Delete |
| Subtitle under every heading | Boilerplate | Keep only if concrete fact not in heading |
| Generic link names ("Learn more") | No info scent | Specific destination ("Read pricing") |
| Arrow on links ("→") | Screen reader noise | Remove (except external ↗, breadcrumb) |
| Em dashes / " - " as dashes | Mannered prose | Comma or period |
| "Seamless", "unlock", "empower" | AI vocabulary | Plain words |
| Mixing icon styles (filled + outline) | Incoherent | One style per hierarchy level |
